objections.claim: The candidate imposes mutually exclusive controller requirements. E1 and §5(b2) require the merge-controller to appear in the bypass_actors list of the pure actor-restriction ruleset so it can update main, while §5(e)'s exact custody manifest requires that same controller to be “excluded from every ruleset bypass list.” Consequently either the custody/configuration oracle rejects the only operable configuration, or the server denies every controller merge. Restrict the exclusion to safety/check-enforcing rulesets and record the required pure actor-restriction membership consistently, with a regression proving the manifest accepts that exact split-ruleset configuration.
